# Check if there is any row where the position is 3rd or higher (i.e., 1st, 2nd, or 3rd)
third_or_higher = df['position'].str.contains(r'^\d*(?:1st|2nd|3rd)$', case=False, na=False).any()

# Check if there is any row where the position is 10th or higher (i.e., 1st through 10th)
tenth_or_higher = df['position'].str.extract(r'(\d+)', expand=False).astype(float).le(10).any()

# The statement is true if both conditions are true
answer = third_or_higher and tenth_or_higher
answer
